expectation: Cytoplasmic/punctate granular signal in scattered single cells (cytotoxic T/NK), rare, in lamina propria and intraepithelial positions of this gut tissue, typically a subset of CD8a+ cells; no signal in epithelium generally.
observed: A: yellow haze follows tissue/epithelial outline, with stripes, banding and edge glow, plus a few bright specks. B: diffuse bands along epithelium/folds, no discrete cells. C: epithelial ring glows uniformly. D: uniform haze with one bright blob. E1/E3: diffuse haze, no GZMB-positive cells on CD8a cells, only a bright corner blob.
why: Signal is diffuse haze following tissue architecture and artefacts, with no discrete cell population or co-localisation with CD8a cells.
notes: GZMB looks like tissue autofluorescence/haze following epithelium and folds, with stripe artefacts. CD8a cells are clear, but GZMB does not sit on them; bright spots are blobs.
